title: Zeros of Quasimodular Forms Defined by Iterated Sums
summary: We study the zeros of the quasimodular forms $G_{\{2\}^n}$ defined by iterated sums. We first show that, for every $n>0$, $G_{\{2\}^n}$ has exactly $n$ simple zeros on each of the vertical half-lines $\Real(τ)=0$ and $\Real(τ)=1/2$, and that the zeros for consecutive values of $n$ satisfy an interlacing property. The proof is based on an expression of $G_{\{2\}^n}$ in terms of the $n$-th derivative of $η^3$ and on the theory of bell-shaped functions, rather than on Rankin--Swinnerton-Dyer method.
